title: 第十八章躲过一劫第十九章坎儿井坊市
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: 面对清虚老道的突然发难，江离一副不知所措，不知该怎么回答的样子。
见江离不说话，清虚老道依旧冷笑。
“我前前后后共给了你八枚纳气丹，便是给一头猪，它也能修到炼气二层，为何你偏偏不够？”
“若是说你炼化速度慢，还情有可原，可偏偏你说是不够！不是在骗我，又是什么！”
江离大惊失色，连忙解释道：“弟子并未说谎，这纳气丹确实不够。”
“每次吞服纳气丹，大部分药力都没有来得及炼化，便消散在了体内，弟子不敢在师尊面前撒谎。”
来之前，江离便已经准备好了说辞。
药力来不及炼化就消散，合情合理。
毕竟这种事，他真的做过。
至于前面那些惊恐的表情，实则也是他装出来的。
“你是一整枚吞服的？”
清虚老道问道。
江离点点头：“正是。”
清虚老道的表情立刻变的有些肉疼。
炼气一层就整枚吞服，药力不消散才怪。
八枚纳气丹，那也是灵石啊！
别看清虚老道的身份相当于一宗之主，但实际上的家底也不过就比散修强上一些而已。
仅是这些解释，依旧无法打消清虚老道的怀疑。
他问道：“你就没有想过要将其分成数份服用吗？”
江离一脸追悔莫及之色，道：“弟子倒是想过。只是害怕将纳气丹破坏，药力会流失。所以一直没敢这么做。”
闻言，清虚老道忍不住叹了口气。
江离之前是小月宗的杂役弟子，没有接触过纳气丹，不知道怎么服用也是在情理之中。
倒也说得过去。
就是可惜了那几枚纳气丹了。
见时机成熟，江离又道：“其实弟子还存有私心。”
不等清虚老道询问，江离再道：“弟子也想学炼丹之法。”
说谎这件事，真话之中参杂一些假话最能让人信服。
江离确实也想学习炼丹之法，这一点不需要怀疑。
清虚老道的表情彻底缓和了下来。
先前的解释虽然合理，但也无法彻底打消他的疑虑。
江离这么一说，使得他的动机更加合理起来。
content_en:
Facing the sudden attack from Master Qingxu, Jiang Li looked at a loss and didn't know how to answer.
Seeing that Jiang Li was silent, Qingxu Old Taoist still sneered.
"I gave you a total of eight Qi Refining Pills. Even if they were given to a pig, it could reach the second level of Qi Refining. Why didn't you get enough?"
"If I said your refining speed is slow, I would be forgiven for it, but you say it's not enough! If you're not lying to me, what are you!"
Jiang Li was horrified and quickly explained: "The disciple did not lie. This Qi-receiving pill is indeed not enough."
"Every time you swallow the Qi Nai Dan, most of the medicine dissipates in the body before it has time to be refined. The disciple dare not lie in front of the master."
Before coming, Jiang Li had already prepared his speech.
The potency of the medicine dissipates before it can be refined, which is reasonable.
After all, he has really done this kind of thing.
As for those frightened expressions in front, he was actually pretending.
"Did you swallow it whole?"
Old Taoist Qingxu asked.
Jiang Li nodded: "Exactly."
Qingxu's expression immediately turned a little painful.
After refining the Qi level, swallow it whole. It would be strange if the potency of the medicine does not dissipate.
The eight qi-receiving pills are also spiritual stones!
Although Old Taoist Qingxu's status is equivalent to that of the head of a sect, his actual family background is only slightly better than that of casual cultivators.
These explanations alone still cannot dispel the suspicion of Qingxu Lao Dao.
He asked: "Have you never thought of dividing it into several portions?"
"Huh?"
Jiang Li had a look of regret on his face and said: "I have thought about it, but I'm just afraid that if I destroy the Qi Nai Dan, the power of the medicine will be lost. So I haven't dared to do it."
Hearing this, Old Taoist Qingxu couldn't help but sigh.
Jiang Li was a handyman disciple of Xiaoyue Sect before. He had never come into contact with the Qi Nai Dan, so it was understandable that he didn't know how to take it.
That makes sense.
It's just a pity that those few Qi-receiving pills were there.
Seeing that the time was ripe, Jiang Li said again: "Actually, this disciple still has selfish motives."
Without waiting for Old Taoist Qingxu to ask, Jiang Li said again: "This disciple also wants to learn the method of alchemy."
When it comes to lying, the truth mixed with some lies is the most convincing.
There is no need to doubt that Jiang Li really wants to learn the method of alchemy.
Old Taoist Qingxu's expression completely softened.
Although the previous explanation was reasonable, it could not completely dispel his doubts.
Jiang Li's words made his motives more reasonable.
